summary: Iteration 22 — Tape Measure (3D renderer) PASSES end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 in test_iter22_measurements.py covering CRUD (list empty/create+GET/delete+GET 404/optional label null with default y=0), cross-user isolation (user_b cannot list/create/delete in user_a's project — all return 404 via _assert_project), no _id leak, auth required (401/403), and full Pydantic validation (distance_ft negative→422, >100000→422, missing start→422, missing end→422, label >120 chars→422, distance=0 accepted, unknown project→404). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL, admin login): seeded project + NYC satellite site + 4-wall 40×30ft blueprint + 1 measurement via API; 3D RENDERER tab → 'TAPE MEASURE' button (testid renderer-measure-start) visible top-right; click → becomes 'EXIT MEASURE' (renderer-measure-stop), measure-tool-panel renders at bottom-center, measure-snap-toggle checked=true by default. Seeded measurement renders in measurement-list as "5' 6\" (5.50 ft)" (ft-in formatter correct). TWO Playwright canvas clicks at 35%/65% width actually produced a NEW measurement (row count 1→2) — raycast against ground plane works via Playwright pointer events (contrary to the agent-to-agent note's caution). Delete via measurement-delete-0 removed it from UI AND from backend (verified via API recount). After reload, persisted measurement (label='persisted', dist=7ft via API) appears as "9' 3\"" in list and renders as in-scene yellow tape annotation in screenshot. EXIT MEASURE hides panel and restores the TAPE MEASURE button.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: MeasurementIn uses Pydantic Field(ge=0, le=100_000) for distance_ft and Field(max_length=120) for optional label — all 422 boundary cases clean. Vec3 nested model has y default 0.0 (correct for 2D tape on ground plane).

GOOD: _assert_project enforces ownership before list/create/delete, so cross-user isolation is automatic via the same 404 path used by all /site routes. Delete also uses {project_id, id} compound match so a measurement_id from project A cannot accidentally delete one in project B.
GOOD: list_measurements sorts by created_at ascending and caps at 500 — safe for typical usage; large projects could hit cap silently but UI shows up to that without slow scroll.
GOOD: create_measurement strips _id before returning (doc.pop('_id', None)) — no MongoDB ObjectId leak.

GOOD: Frontend uses formatFtIn(ft) producing the requested 5a format (e.g. "5' 6\"") in rows; both the list row and the in-scene 3D label show the same value. Snap default ON matches choice 2c, panel-only grid (hidden otherwise) matches that choice. Per-measurement delete UI works and stays in sync with backend after deletion.

MINOR: SNAP toggle (measure-snap-toggle) is a styled <input type=checkbox> — accessible via is_checked() in Playwright; good. No ARIA label though — consider adding aria-label='snap-to-grid' for screen readers.

NOTE: Canvas raycast DOES work through Playwright mouse.click on the WebGL canvas — measurements were created by Playwright dispatching click events on the canvas at 35%/65% width × 55% height. The agent-to-agent note suggesting it might not work is overly cautious; for future testers, the raycast against ground plane responds to standard pointer events.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (button state transition, panel open, snap default, list render w/ ft-in, canvas-click measure creation, delete via X synced with backend, reload persistence, EXIT MEASURE state restore — all verified)
